title: Bug: Issue with Morph target parsing in .fbx file

labels.name: Bug
labels.description: Global flag to mark a deviation from expected behaviour

labels.name: Blend shapes
labels.description: Related to blend shapes/morph meshes (animation via changes to identical vertices via weights)

body:
I want to report an issue I've noticed with the parsing of morph targets in .fbx files (or mAnimMeshes as they're called).

It seems that they are not tied to the proper aiMesh.
In other words: aiMesh::mAnimMeshes isn't properly querying the morphs for that mesh, it can be querying mAnimMeshes that belong to another aiMesh in that model file /aiScene.

I am using v5.4.1 (published on May 13, 2024).

Now the source code of that version has this comment:

```
/**
 * Attachment meshes for this mesh, for vertex-based animation.
 * Attachment meshes carry replacement data for some of the
 * mesh'es vertex components (usually positions, normals).
 * Currently known to work with loaders:
 * - Collada
 * - gltf
 */
C_STRUCT aiAnimMesh **mAnimMeshes;
```

which means that it's a known issue on that version.
I don't know if that issue has been fixed in newer version and honestly I don't want to update, because the last time I attempted to do so (2-3 months ago), I experienced multiple other more serious issues which were not present in v5.4.1. So I really don't want to update, unless I have no other choice.

Any workarounds, plans to fix, tips, something?
